name: Tax Justice Network
summary: A research and advocacy organisation founded in 2003 and run as a UK non-profit company limited by guarantee (not a registered charity), with a remote team of about 33 in 14 countries. It proposed automatic exchange of tax information, public registers of who owns companies and country-by-country reporting by multinationals, now international standards; publishes the Financial Secrecy Index, the Corporate Tax Haven Index and the State of Tax Justice reports; works with tax authorities on their own data; and campaigns for the UN tax convention now being negotiated. It spent GBP 2.09 million in 2025.

spending.source: https://taxjustice.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Tax-Justice-Network-Annual-Report-2025.pdf (audited statement of financial activities, year ended 31 December 2025, p. 31: charitable activities GBP 2,032,339 of GBP 2,086,693 total expenditure, the rest raising funds; support and governance costs already allocated, note 7, p. 43; at the IRS 2025 average of 1.3175 dollars per pound)

lines.label: Research, policy, advocacy and communications on tax justice (indices, State of Tax Justice, beneficial ownership, country-by-country reporting, the UN tax convention, human rights)
